fr_html: Ces considérations ont amené M. Ricci-Busatti à proposer une Cour où chaque Etat aura un représentant; la Cour sera divisée en plusieurs sections; les Présidents de ces sections, élus en séance plénière, formeront le noyau de la Cour.
en_html: These considerations had led M. Ricci-Busatti to propose a Court on which each State would have one representative; the Court would be divided into several sections; the Presidents of these sections, elected in full session, would form the nucleus of the Court.
